title: Scenario
description: A cash scenario (engine-spec §2/§5): which events count and how they are shifted or scaled. Order of application (engine-spec §12.2/§12.4): events the snapshot already reflects are removed first (judged on the original event); then expected events are dropped (include_expected=false), overrides applied, expected inflows delayed and scaled, 'living' outflows scaled; an event whose date changed loses its timestamp; one moved before the snapshot day counts on the snapshot day. Per engine-spec §2 a plan input carries at least a confirmed-only and a baseline scenario and may carry stress scenarios; outputs list scenarios in input order.

include_expected.description: false = confirmed-only view (every 'expected' event is dropped).

income_delay_days.description: Delay applied to every expected inflow.

income_scale.description: Factor on expected inflows (rounded half up to the minor unit).

expense_scale.description: Factor on outflows of category 'living' (rounded half up to the minor unit).

event_overrides.description: Per-event replacement of date and/or amount, applied before delay and scaling. Each event at most once; the event must exist.

same_day_order.description: conservative = outflows before inflows; timestamp = by 'at' when every event of the day has one.
